name: Venomancer: Improved Harden and Shedder reduce cooldowns (#2911, #2923)
contract: #2911 and #2923: Improved Harden (705971/705972) is a flat SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11) of -20000/-40000 ms on family 35 word0 0x40000 = Harden (800892, RecoveryTime 180000). Shedder (705990) is a PCT SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN of -20% on word2 0x4 = every Expulsion rank (CategoryRecoveryTime 10000; Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies the modifier to the category cooldown). Native modifier queries only; no cast is submitted. Barbed Stinger (803196) and Regrow Exoskeleton (803197) also clear Exposed Flesh but are outside Shedder's mask (asserted unchanged so the current data is pinned).

steps.label: Harden cooldown is 180 s without Improved Harden
Expulsion cooldown is 10 s without Shedder
Improved Harden rank 1 gives a 160 s Harden cooldown
Improved Harden rank 2 gives a 140 s Harden cooldown
Shedder gives an 8 s Expulsion cooldown
Shedder reaches the top Expulsion rank
Shedder does not change Barbed Stinger's cooldown
Shedder does not change Regrow Exoskeleton's cooldown
